bullets.text: Russian officials reported that a Ukrainian drone strike deep within Russia killed at least 13 people and injured 75, marking one of the deadliest such attacks since the full-scale invasion.
Global oceans experienced their hottest July on record, partly due to developing El Niño conditions, while wildfires continue to spread across western Europe and Canada.
A 7.4-magnitude earthquake in western Colombia has resulted in scores of deaths and the collapse of buildings in several major cities, with people reportedly trapped in Cali.
South Australia is pioneering a royal commission into AI, following its global lead in restricting children's social media access, potentially influencing national policy.
An accident involving an Australian-contracted aircraft in Antarctica has prompted new safety protocols on the continent, according to internal government documents.
Australians across the country are expected to complete the 2026 Census form today as it is officially Census Day.
Wall Street giants including Apollo, Blackstone, and Goldman Sachs are partnering with Nvidia to raise $500 billion for AI financing, aiming to fund the booming data center industry.
Gold prices are nearing $4,400 per ounce as traders assess the standoff in the Strait of Hormuz and await a key US inflation report, contributing to weakening emerging-market currencies.
India's IT sector is adapting to artificial intelligence, which is creating challenges for many graduates, while China is emerging as a significant oil power, influencing global energy dynamics.
